title: Storage Rental Collections Standard: Overlock and Release
content:
A Storage Rental unit is overlocked when its oldest past-due storage charge has been past due for more than the product's past-due period, and the product's overlock fee posts. The overlock is removed only after the whole storage balance, the overlock fee included, is paid.

## Terms

**Past-due age.** The number of days, as of the day it is evaluated, since the posting date of the oldest storage charge on the rental that is not fully paid, with the rental's payments and credits applied to its charges oldest first.

**Overlock.** When the past-due age exceeds the product's past-due period, the unit is overlocked (the rental's status moves from active to overlocked) and the overlock fee posts on the Storage Rental.

**Release.** The overlock is removed, and the rental returns to active, only after the whole storage balance, the overlock fee included, is paid.

**Limits of an overlock.** Larkspur never sells or disposes of stored contents for non-payment while the lease is in possession. An overlock restricts only the storage unit and never access to the apartment home, parking or amenities.

## The threshold on both sides (hypothetical rental, 30-day past-due period)

| Past-due age of the oldest open storage charge | Exceeds 30? | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 30 days | No | Not overlocked |
| 31 days | Yes | Overlocked; the overlock fee posts |

## Finding the oldest open charge (hypothetical ledger)

A Standard Storage Unit (5x5) rental shows rent of $55.00 posted on the 1st of month one and $55.00 posted on the 1st of month two, and a single $55.00 payment. Applied oldest first, the payment clears the month-one rent in full. The oldest charge not fully paid is therefore the month-two rent, and the past-due age runs from the 1st of month two.

## Release at the boundary (hypothetical overlocked rental)

| Payment received | Whole storage balance, overlock fee included, paid? | Overlock |
|---|---|---|
| Past-due rent only, overlock fee still open | No | Remains |
| Past-due rent and the overlock fee, nothing else open | Yes | Removed |

## Points of judgement

- **What the overlock touches.** The storage unit only. The apartment home, parking and amenities stay accessible.
- **Stored contents.** While the lease is in possession, stored contents are never sold or disposed of for non-payment.
- **Which charge sets the clock.** The oldest storage charge not fully paid after payments and credits are applied oldest first.
